headlines.title: Fed raises interest rates for first time since 2023, defying Trump as inflation mounts
headlines.description: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday raised its benchmark interest rates for the first time since 2023, in a move aimed at slowing inflation.

headlines.title: Third victim identified as Los Angeles reels from deadly news helicopter crash
headlines.description: Investigators are searching for answers after three people were killed when a helicopter providing coverage for NBC Los Angeles and Telemundo 52 went down on Tuesday night. NBC News' Steve Patterson reports on the victims while Tom Costello gives context on the crash investigation.

headlines.title: House to leave early, punting Hegseth impeachment vote until after November elections
headlines.description: House lawmakers will leave early for the November midterm elections after Republican leaders canceled votes for Thursday.

headlines.title: Ed Sheeran’s Opening Acts Drop out in Solidarity With Macklemore
headlines.description: Fallout is growing over rapper Macklemore’s removal from Ed Sheeran’s tour with now every one of Sheeran’s music openers and his onstage band announcing that they would no longer take part in the tour. Sheeran is also speaking out, saying “Macklemore coming off tour was the promoter’s decision, it was not mine.” NBC’s Liz Kreutz reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Colin Kaepernick on Memoir, Whether He Would Still Play in NFL

headlines.title: Supreme Court pushes back against Trump and GOP ahead of the midterm elections
headlines.description: The Supreme Court’s recent rulings on mail-in ballots and redistricting foreshadow a frosty reception to further attempts to change the rules before the election, experts said.

headlines.title: Apple’s record night and Colbert’s Emmys wins highlight TV in transition
headlines.description: Apple took home a total of 28 trophies, with a record 14 for freshman comedy “Widow’s Bay.”

headlines.title: Texas college quarterback apologizes for comments about violent AI video
headlines.description: Texas Longhorns quarterback Arch Manning apologized for referencing an AI video showing his coach slapping ESPN sideline reporter Holly Rowe. “In my press conference yesterday, I made an insensitive comment about an AI video. There is nothing funny about it,” Manning wrote.

headlines.title: Alex Ovechkin, all-time NHL goal scorer, appears in ad supporting Vladimir Putin
headlines.description: Washington Capitals forward and NHL all-time leading goal scorer Alex Ovechkin appeared in an ad backing Russian President Vladimir Putin.

headlines.title: White House chief of staff Susie Wiles says she’s cancer-free
headlines.description: White House chief of staff Susie Wiles announced Wednesday that she is now cancer-free after being diagnosed with breast cancer in March.

headlines.title: House votes to hold Epstein associate Leon Black in contempt of Congress
headlines.description: The House of Representatives voted unanimously Wednesday to find billionaire Leon Black in contempt of Congress for refusing to comply with subpoenas related to a congressional probe into the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.
